summary:
**ORBIT FORGE – Build Beyond Boundaries**

ORBIT FORGE is an interactive, space-themed web experience designed to make spacecraft preparation and mission simulation more engaging and accessible. We've developed a web-game where users can explore a mission through spacecraft configuration, component assembly and simulation.

The project combines an immersive space-inspired interface with interactive elements and 3D visual experiences to help users understand the stages involved in preparing a spacecraft for a mission. Instead of presenting the process as static information, ORBIT FORGE aims to make exploration more intuitive, and hands-on.

This project is important because space technology often feels complex and difficult to approach to many of them. But we've turned that complex space technology into an interactive experience. I believe ORBIT FORGE will help users understand about the complex space tech without any hassle. 

**Our vision is simple: make space exploration something people can experience, not just observe.**
details:
Project Details – ORBIT FORGE

ORBIT FORGE started with a simple idea: what if people could experience the process of preparing for a space mission instead of just reading about it?

We developed an interactive, space-themed web -game that takes users through different stages of a mission, including spacecraft configuration, component assembly, simulation. We wanted to create something that feels engaging and hands-on, while also giving users a better understanding of how different parts of a space mission come together.

This web game is not flabbergasting but it's a simple web game that users might enjoy learning while playing game which Gen Z would particularly love. It's just a simple model now , but we're going to make it much more interesting, like managing resources for astronaut and thrust controllers , energy managers and much more .

The main benefit of ORBIT FORGE is that it makes a complex topic feel more approachable. Space exploration involves a lot of technology and planning, and it will be difficult for someone new to the subject to understand how everything works. Our(ORBIT FORGE) goal is to make that learning experience more visual, interactive and enjoyable. We hope the project encourages users to be curious to learn and explore space and its tech.

We built the platform using React and JavaScript, with Vite for development. We also used Three.js, React Three Fiber and Drei to bring 3D elements into the experience. HTML and CSS helped us structure and style the interface. We focused mainly on creating a dark, space-inspired design with animations related to space, interactive components and visual elements that make the experience feel closer to an actual mission-control environment.

What makes ORBIT FORGE special to us is the way we tried to combine learning with interaction. We didn't complicate it by adding 100s of buttons and intricate parts of the SPACECRAFT; rather, we've used simple, layman-understandable components so that users entering our web-game shouldn't leave empty-brained; they'll for sure take something from us that will help them to understand more about space .

As a team, we know this is only a starting point, but we hope ORBIT FORGE can grow into a platform that makes learning about spacecraft and space missions more exciting and accessible. We don't just want people to read about space missions. We want them to feel like they're part of one.
